in_sanskrit.name: Bamaniya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed with God's protection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bamaniya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bama’, meaning ‘Lord of the Earth’. The suffix ‘niya’ denotes protection. Thus, Bamaniya means ‘Blessed with God’s protection’. This name is revered in Hindu mythology and holds significant spiritual importance.

in_hindi.name: बामनिया
in_hindi.meaning: बाम (lame) + निय (belonging to) + आ (to) = बामनिया (belonging to the lame)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Person belonging to a community of people with physical disabilities or a person with a limp.
